hook: The task that used to eat my Sundays. Now it runs itself
caption:
The task that used to eat my Sundays. Now it runs itself.

Before: a manual scan every single week. Half the leads missed entirely, half found too late to act on.

Now: the agent filters by criteria. Region, budget, category, timing — only sends what actually fits.

Not magic. One recurring weekly task I used to do by hand, checked against the same criteria every time — now it just happens on its own.

Still scanning manually every week? DM me AGENT — I'll show you how it works.
